source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 1 同主题完形(开学第一天/加入社团/克服紧张/适应新班级/校园友谊/给学弟妹的话)。用词限 U1/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: My First Day at Senior High

passages.title: Beating the First-Week Nerves
passages.text: The first week of a new school can be confusing, and almost every student feels a little (1)____ at the start. passages.title: Fitting into a New Class

passages.title: What School Friendship Means

passages.title: A Word to New Students
